title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of square tiles seen from a raised front angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left (front-left) square; a raised orange disc marks the goal on the top-right (back-right) square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a yellow arrow on the token pointing along a move one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps still to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the marked goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes one row or one column. The goal is 2 rows up and 2 columns right, so the shortest route is 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means toward the back of the board as seen from the starting camera. Reset always returns the token to the same start; the hint arrow points right while the goal is to the right, otherwise up.
